product.name: Engineering PC „easy engineer“
product.version: example v0.40, 26 Oct 2026 (working group), template v0.39

SP.title: Password protection for PLC programs
SP.desc: The Engineering software has a feature to password protect PLC program files. Strong passwords are enforced (password complexity requirements can be set by role “admin”).

SP.title: Malware protection
SP.desc: The Engineering PC by default has Windows Defender enabled for malware protection.

SP.title: User notification in case of PLC program file change
SP.desc: The engineering software regularly checks the stored PLC program files and notifies users as soon as a file change occurs that hasn’t been initiated by the user itself.

SP.title: Disabling of unused USB ports
SP.desc: Any unused USB ports are disabled by default. They can temporarily be enabled e.g. for security updates via USB (see chapter 3.4.1 Function FC04 Install security updates).

FC.title: Program a PLC
FC.desc: Creation and modification of PLC programs on the engineering PC and transfer of these programs to the PLC.
FC.rfu: Transfer of the PLC programs to the PLC using the USB port.

FC.title: Simulate PLC code
FC.desc: PLC programs can be simulated on the Engineering PC for testing purposes before transferring them to the PLC.

FC.title: Troubleshoot from remote
FC.desc: Access and administrate the Engineering PC remotely for troubleshooting purposes. The available diagnostic capabilities support the identification of faults and irregularities in system behaviour, but not the change of PLC programs.

FC.title: Install security updates
FC.desc: Installation of security updates by downloading them from the manufacturer’s webserver (CC06 Manufacturer update server) to a PC (CC03 Maintenance PC) and then connecting the Maintenance PC to the Engineering PC via USB for transfer and installation of the updates.

CC.title: PLC
CC.desc: The Programmable Logic Controller (PLC) that can be programmed using the Engineering PC.

CC.title: Network
CC.desc: A network connecting the Engineering PC to the PLC(s) to be programmed.

CC.title: Maintenance PC
CC.desc: A laptop or PC used by maintenance staff.

CC.title: VPN termination
CC.desc: A device to terminate a VPN connection.

CC.title: Manufacturer PC
CC.desc: A laptop or PC used by manufacturer staff.

CC.title: Manufacturer update server
CC.desc: The webserver the manufacturer uses to provide security updates.

CP.title: Engineer
CP.desc: The person who uses the Engineering PC to program PLCs.

CP.title: Manufacturer staff
CP.desc: The person(s) responsible for troubleshooting the Engineering PC (manufacturer support).

CP.title: Maintenance staff
CP.desc: The person(s) responsible for the installation of security updates on the Engineering PC.

CZ.title: product user zone
CZ.desc: Components and persons internal to the product user’s organization

CZ.title: manufacturer zone
CZ.desc: Components and persons external to the product user’s organization (internal to the manufacturer’s organization)

CU.title: No internet connection
CU.desc: The Engineering PC operates exclusively within a closed network segment with dedicated communication channels.

CU.title: Regular PLC code integrity checks
CU.desc: Regular integrity checks of the PLC code must be performed to ensure that only verified and unchanged code is executed on the PLC. This requirement lies outside the product boundary and must be fulfilled by the operator as part of the system environment.

CU.title: Physical access control
CU.desc: There must be physical access control in place for the organization’s premises, the Engineering PC and the PLC.

CU.title: VPN access manually enabled per use
CU.desc: The VPN connection is disabled by default and only gets manually enabled when there is a maintenance case requiring remote access.

CU.title: No local admin accounts
CU.desc: Administrative rights are assigned exclusively through the central identity management system. Only centrally managed and authenticated user accounts are permitted to access the system.

CU.title: Temporary / restricted internet access
CU.desc: The Maintenance PC is only temporarily connected to the internet and the accessible URLs are restricted.

CU.title: Restrict internet access to manufacturer URL
CU.desc: The Maintenance PC is technically restricted to only download files from the manufacturer URL.

CU.title: Integrity check of downloaded file
CU.desc: After downloading a security update file from the manufacturer website, maintenance staff checks the provided hash to assure the integrity of the provided security update file.

RI.title: No PLC code integrity checks
RI.desc: The user never verifies the integrity of the PLC code on the PLC.
RI.damage: If manipulations of PLC code happen, they are not detected and can cause harm to the controlled process.

RI.title: Physically unprotected perimeter
RI.desc: The organization’s perimeter is physically accessible without restriction.
RI.damage: The product can be accessed, manipulated, sabotaged, or destroyed by unauthorized persons in a way that disrupts its core functions.

RI.title: Physically unprotected product
RI.desc: The Engineering PC is physically accessible for all employees.
RI.damage: The product can be used by unauthorized and / or unskilled persons in a way that disrupts core functions.

RI.title: Connection of the PLC to the public internet
RI.desc: The PLC or the PLC network are connected to the public internet.
RI.damage: Files can be downloaded to the PLC from the public internet. In the worst case, the PLC is accessible from the public internet.

RI.title: Permanently open VPN connection
RI.desc: The VPN connection permanently remains enabled for use, even if there is no open maintenance case.
RI.damage: Remote access can be misused for malicious activities.

RI.title: Local admin account enabled on the product
RI.desc: The user creates a local admin account.
RI.damage: In case of an unauthorized access or malware installation, the impact on the product can be more severe because privileged resources can be accessed.

RI.title: Product is connected to the internet
RI.desc: The temporary internet connection to the Maintenance PC is not disabled when downloaded updates onto the Engineering PC or the PLC network is connected to the internet.
RI.damage: Files containing malware might be installed on the product or remote access to the product may be possible.

RI.title: Download of security updates from untrusted source
RI.desc: Software updates are downloaded from other sources than the URL provided.
RI.damage: Files containing malware might be installed on the product.

RI.title: Failure to check security update integrity
RI.desc: Maintenance staff does not check the provided hash to assure the integrity of the provided security update file.
RI.damage: Files containing malware might be installed on the product.
